title: Technical Lead – Software
requiredSkills: He/She will work as the Software Lead for our Ongoing Embedded Project.
Candidate will be responsible for Designing and developing the MISRA compliant code from the architecture or requirement document which must be compatible with the in-house designed hardware.
A sound knowledge of coding standards, communication protocols, debugging techniques, developing low level and high level design for the software is required.
Additionally he/she will be leading a hardware team
B.E/B.Tech (Electronics/Electrical/Computer Science)
CDAC certification (VLSI or similar) will be considered as an added advantage

title: Technical Member (Verification & Validation)
requiredSkills: He/She will work as the member of V&V team for our Ongoing Embedded Projects.
Candidate will be responsible for designing test cases and test vectors for the given product.
Scope of the test will be from unit test till function test at vehicle level.
At later stage of the product development, coordinating field test and tests on the track will be the responsibility of the member.
He/she must have good Experience of handling sophisticated test equipment and handling product certification such as EMI/EMC etc will be added advantage.
B.E/B.Tech (Electronics/Electrical/Computer Science)
CDAC or VLSI will be considered as an added advantage
